name.en: Birkenia elegans — conservative scaled jawless fish

scope: Original whole jawless anaspid based on complete articulated cast specimens and taxonomic reconstruction. Correct orientation; not an ordinary fish fitted with spines.

taxon.context: Silurian, early Wenlock of Scotland; no detailed habitat or direct-ancestor claim.
anchors: Blom, Märss & Miller2002(for2001) Fig11 KIMMG:Vf6/7 part/counterpart latex casts

scale.basis: Artist nominal8cm within primary up-to10cm account; exact width/soft thickness and posed bounds inferred, not measured replica.

pose: Neutral horizontal aquatic pose, small blunt jawless mouth closed/minimally defined; tail orientation with extended LOWER lobe. No stand or floor contact.

surface_profile.name: palette-only
surface_profile.materials: 4–6 subdued gray/olive/slate/tan palette values, not fossil pigment claim. No emissive eyes.
surface_profile.detail: Closed thin-solid fins, single-sided materials; no paper-thin DoubleSide planes. Selective facet/scale structure, no thousands of separate scales or detached bead objects.

coordinates.origin: Model centerline projected to lowest-body reference plane at Z0; neutral unsupported swimming pose, no stand. State exact bounds.

view_plan.source: Exact final GLB clean-import, fixed numeric camera/light/color template and hash-bound manifest.
view_plan.greybox: Inspect silhouette/body thickness and all fin placements before detail.
view_plan.extra_views: Only targeted diagnostic for concrete ambiguity; no mandatory8 views in current scoped making.

scientific_limits: Whole external dermal armor well documented; exact live thickness, soft tissue, eye appearance and colors are art, not preserved pigment.
Use species-specific Fig5D, not neighboring Fig5A–C species or generic Fig6 fins. Fig11 is actual latex cast of fossil external mould, not unmodified fossil photograph.
Historical Traquair upside-down/heterocercal reconstructions excluded. Strongly hypocercal tail has axial elongation directed into LOWER lobe; never reverse to shark-like upper extension.

Small ventrolateral plate/postbranchial spine area remains close to body. Do not add speculative large paired pectoral/pelvic fan membranes or copy generic Fig6 ventrolateral fin. Distal soft fold extent is not approved here.

Dorsal ridge consists of enlarged scales/spines, including diagnostic double-headed element; not a ray-bearing continuous dorsal sail. Exact repeated ridge-spine count is stylized, not universal species meristic assertion.
Fine tubercles and exact sutures not required individually. Eight branchial openings per side represented understated; no drilled through-holes or fish operculum copied from jawed fish.
JNCC PDF figure2.11A photograph is missing/blank in downloaded file; NOT an inspected photo. Figure2.11B historical restoration is context only, modern primary cast anchors take priority.

morphology.obligation: Small elongate laterally compressed spindle with compact head; tapering caudal peduncle, not a broad circular Dapedium body. Finite width clear in front/top.
morphology.source: Blom et al Fig11 casts, Fig5D.

morphology.obligation: Jawless rounded front with small simple mouth, two small lateral eyes; one slanted row of8 understated branchial marks on each side, leading to small postbranchial plate/spine region. No toothed jaws, gaping predatory mouth or bony helmet.
morphology.source: Family diagnosis8 openings, species Fig11 and head scales; exact surface relief simplified.

morphology.obligation: Long narrow scale elements grouped into coherent oblique flank rows; orientation changes over dorsal/ventral regions, giving ordered herringbone-like armor rather than round scales or spikes. Small head plates. Avoid thousands of disconnected pieces; prefer integrated faceted relief/bands.
morphology.source: Species diagnosis, Fig11 whole rows and Fig14 scale detail.

morphology.obligation: Low midline series of raised dorsal ridge elements; a prominent but small double-headed spine points both fore and aft around mid-back, followed by smaller swept ridge spines. No tall fin web connecting them.
morphology.source: Species diagnosis and Fig11/14; silhouette simplification declared.

morphology.obligation: Asymmetric hypocercal caudal fin, LOWER lobe longer; small short anal fin on lower posterior trunk, not paired pelvic fans. Keep median fin/web finite thin-solid and distinct from belly.

acceptance_obligations: Four exactGLB front/side/top/perspective. Side mandatory: lower-long hypocercal tail, double-headed dorsal spine, short anal fin, ordered flank rows. Front/top: narrow but volumetric body and bilateral head/branchial region. Perspective: clean integrated armor, finite fin/spine thickness and no floating plates.
No large pectoral/pelvic fans, no continuous dorsal sail, no upper-long shark tail, no hinged tooth jaw. Generic neighboring taxon diagrams cannot override species Fig5D/11.
Dorsal-spine simplification and small ventrolateral region documented. If tiny branchial row ambiguous, targeted close-up allowed instead of mandatory8 views.

Single-sided closed thin solids, outward normals, no DoubleSide masking. Two complete deterministic builds and semantic digests, shared default helpers, source/exactGLB reports and official validation.
Independent morphology QA; full production/GPU/scene/user acceptance remain separate unclaimed.
production_boundary: Full static-stylized-v1 production8/GPU/scene contract is retained as reference but NOT claimed passed or imposed as current maker scope; user-requested4view model acceptance is separate.
